clusters.mechanism: Runtime catalog removal goes through editable(), which finds the shadowing built-in and throws read-only, so the redundant runtime_models row can never be removed and the startup warning repeats forever.
Collision handling is hardcoded to the single id 'claude/haiku-5.5' rather than a general rule, so any other runtime/built-in id collision still throws 'catalog collision' at startup.
Pin test hardcodes the decision date and eval ids instead of reading them from overrides.json, so each new owner decision requires a test edit.
As a built-in, Haiku 5.5 now joins widened candidate chains in every role, a behaviour change the frozen identity snapshot test hides by stripping it from the snapshot.
Replacing the runtime entry with the built-in makes RuntimePolicy validation reject stored operator routing cells using efforts the built-in doesn't support, so startup can still fail.
The triage.default reason text overwrites earlier decision history rather than appending to it, so the pin message loses rationale for the rest of the chain.
